post.description: Availability is advisory. Create or reschedule remains the authoritative transactional slot check.
The customer ID, price, duration, service end, and buffer are server derived. `409` can represent a stale slot or lifecycle idempotency conflict; use its error code to distinguish outcomes.

Customers may cancel their own confirmed appointments until 24 hours before start. The same endpoint permits an authorized administrator to cancel outside that customer cutoff; no admin-specific v1 endpoint exists.

SupabaseSession.name: sb-<project-ref>-auth-token
SupabaseSession.description: A browser session cookie issued by the configured Supabase project. `<project-ref>` is derived from the deployment's Supabase URL, and Supabase may chunk the cookie. Clients should use the authenticated browser cookie jar.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque nonblank key, at most 255 characters. Reuse it only to retry the identical lifecycle request within its 24-hour retention window.

Uuid.description: PostgreSQL UUID text (any RFC 4122 version, including deterministic seed IDs).

error.description: `code` is `VALIDATION_ERROR`; `details` identifies invalid body, header, or path fields.

groomerId.description: Specific groomer UUID, or `null` for any qualified active groomer.

startsAt.description: Requested slot instant. The server derives all duration, buffer, and price fields.
